say:0:1711149411:0.text: The expensive custom-made tombstone, the missing classified report, the meticulous will, and the immaculate grave...
say:0:1711149411:0.source_cn: 无论是提前定制的昂贵墓碑、失窃的绝密报告、违背常理的紧...

say:1:1711149412:0.text: Everything points toward the same conclusion.
say:1:1711149412:0.source_cn: 这一切的背后，都指向了同一个荒谬的真相。

say:4:1711171001:0.text: His scheme has been exposed. The high-tier arcane backlash was a lie, and there's no body in that specially sealed coffin.
say:4:1711171001:0.source_cn: 现在，克拉夫特的计划已经被彻底揭穿——高阶以太分解反应...

say:5:1711171002:0.text: Kraff faked his own death, and that pristine grave may very well be the key to finding him.
say:5:1711171002:0.source_cn: 克拉夫特伪造了自己的死亡，而那个一尘不染的墓地，极有可...

say:7:1711149027:1.text: Hiding in a cemetery... how brazen of him.
say:7:1711149027:1.source_cn: 他实在太大胆了，居然敢藏在墓地里……

say:8:1711149028:1.text: ... Oh no. That means he heard me, when I was cursing him out in the cemetery last time!
say:8:1711149028:1.source_cn: ……糟糕，那我上次在墓园骂他的话，岂不是全被这个死人听见了！

say:10:1711149029:1.text: We have to find him. Magister Merlin, leave this to Silven and me. After all, Kraff was once a member of the Arcane Affairs Office.
say:10:1711149029:1.source_cn: 必须得找到他！梅林大人，这件事就交给我和休来办吧，毕竟...
say:10:1711149029:1.male: We have to find him. Magister Merlin, leave this to Silven and me. After all, Kraff was once a member of the Arcane Affairs Office.
say:10:1711149029:1.female: We have to find him. Magister Merlin, leave this to Silven and me. After all, Kraff was once a member of the Arcane Affairs Office.

say:11:1711149030:1.text: Right! Please, wait here. We'll go drag him back!
say:11:1711149030:1.source_cn: 当然，请梅林大人在这里稍作等候。我和科丝蒂这就前往墓园...
say:11:1711149030:1.male: Right! Please, wait here. We'll go drag him back!
say:11:1711149030:1.female: Right! Please, wait here. We'll go drag him back!

say:13:1711149031:1.text: We'll be careful! Let's go, Cassadee.
say:13:1711149031:1.source_cn: 我们会注意的！科丝蒂，我们走！

choice:12:1:2.text: He might have a backup plan.
choice:12:1:2.male: He might have a backup plan.
